claim.summary: Over any field, in a fixed degree-D PC pseudoideal, an acyclic product-only source with structural product weights s_a=h_a(delta_a+1)<=L, old coefficient maps of degree<=T>=1 and one fixed degree-b weight W has unique weighted product classes across successful prefix maps at b+2TL<=D. If any successful complete map exists, every successful prefix extends using its own coefficients followed by the complete map's coefficient polynomials with coherent rebuilding. Whole blocks from arbitrary successful complete maps with the same W,T can likewise be recombined. Block-local coefficient restrictions and supplied weighted coefficient-field memberships are retained; cross-block constraints, separate weights and individual-row mixing are not covered. Booleanity and weight survival are unnecessary for comparison. The proof uses actual-degree PC reuse, not uniform smaller NS certificates.
claim.assessment: Working all-field source-wide extension of the existing companion product comparison, passed by one fresh medium reviewer; constructs neither a common weight nor a first successful block.

claim.summary: For an acyclic binary ENS source with structural product weights s_a=h_a(delta_a+1)<=L, an old Boolean degree-D pseudoideal J2 and E=F_(2^e), suppose a degree-b surviving W and degree<=T>=1 old-polynomial coefficient maps Phi satisfy all weighted companion images, without fresh-field images. At b+3TL<=D, any unital coefficientwise trace applied to all coefficient maps gives one binary map Phi0 with W(Phi(P_a)-Phi0(P_a)) and all new weighted companions in J_E. New fresh fields also vanish; some binary coefficient component w of W survives and kills all new source generators. Factorwise Frobenius closure plus acyclic rebuilding proves the claim; ordinary NS cofactor bounds or rank retention are not asserted. With original replay ceiling B, pay b+T max(B,3L).
claim.assessment: Working complete proof, medium-reviewed after clarifying fixed raw coefficients during intermediate rebuilding and old-generator membership for replay. Exact finite controls passed; no map-existence or lower-bound claim.

claim.summary: For an acyclic binary product-only ENS source with degree<=T binary coefficient maps in identical row spaces, original s_a=h_a(delta_a+1), B>=max(2,max_a(s_a+delta_a)) and b+TB<=D, independent invertible binary constant row operations in each block preserve all weighted product and companion classes in the old Boolean pseudoideal, after coherent rebuilding. Elementary row addition changes the product by (A^2+A) times other factors, certified through Ts_a; descendant telescoping pays original expression weights. Thus successful maps have reduced-row-echelon coefficient matrices at the same degree and original accuracy. Rank/pivot patterns define affine binary gauges covering geometric existence at b+T max(B,3L)<=D after descent; no success is asserted for a particular pattern or for nonbinary row maps.
